The human body is frequently referred to as a", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "‘house’; for therein dwells the soul. यावच्च &c.—and as long as", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "the senses retain their faculties unimpaired. The last line very", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "pithily expresses an idea which brings home to the most", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "careless reader the necessity for striving to save his soul.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r3", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 77. “Human life being only as long as a few twinklings", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "of the eye, how are we, the poet asks, to secure the four पुरुषार्थs", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "viz. धर्म, अर्थ, काम, and मोक्ष ?” This seems to be what Rámarshi", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "thinks of the verse. The reference to अर्थ in the text is of the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "faintest character. सुरनदीम्—वस् with अधि governs the acc ; नि", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "however, is not mentioned among the prepositions given in the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "sútra. Mark the alliteration in this sl.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r4", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 78. अमी—so well known. तुरगचलचित्ताः—neither very", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "common nor a good simile; a horse is known for fleetness and", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "not for fickleness. It simply means here ‘restless like a spirited", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "horse’. Cf. In line 4 the word अन्यत्र seems to be redundant,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "as we have already अन्यत्.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r5", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 79. वसुनि खण्डिते—Rámarshi explains this as ‘wealth", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "being partitioned out’; in connection with the last two lines,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "however, this primary meaning will not suit; and we must have", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "the secondary sense ‘ wealth being destroyed ’ here. व्यर्थम्—", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "( वि+अर्थम् ) without getting any money ( in charity, for which", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "he comes ). जह्नुकन्या—The Ganges is so called from the king", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "Jahnu. ‘ The river Ganges, when brought down from heaven", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "by the austerities of Bhagîratha ( See N'i. S'a. sl. 10. ), was", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "forced to flow over earth to follow him to the lower regions.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 10, "text": "In its course it inundated the sacrificial ground of king Jahnu", "end": "space"}, {"n": 11, "text": "who being angry drank up its waters. But the gods and sages,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 12, "text": "and particularly Bhagiratha, appeased his anger, and he con-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 13, "text": "sented to discharge those waters from his ears. The river is", "end": "space"}, {"n": 14, "text": "therefore regarded as his daughter. ” Apte’s Sk.
